examples.title: Expandable sections
examples.description: The default type is multiple and the value is an array of open item names.

examples.title: Both variants
examples.description: default uses dividers; bordered adds an enclosing border. Both use the same item, trigger and content APIs.

examples.title: Single open item
examples.description: type=single allows one item at a time. Its value is still a string array, including an empty array for all closed.

examples.title: Controlled expansion
examples.description: value and onValueChange let the parent expand all or close all. Arrow keys, Home and End navigate enabled triggers.

examples.title: Disabled item and chevron
examples.description: Disabled items cannot activate and are skipped by trigger arrow navigation. showChevron changes only the visible glyph.
